intro: Lar Prowltusk is a Darkspear troll sentinel stationed southwest of Sen'jin Village in Durotar. From his post on the frontier, he keeps watch over encroaching threats to the young troll settlement, directing adventurers to blunt the advances of nearby enemies.

p: Situated southwest of Sen'jin Village along the rugged Durotar coastline, Lar Prowltusk stands as one of the Darkspear tribe's forward sentinels. With the trolls still working to secure a permanent home after fleeing their sunken island chain, Sen'jin Village faces constant harassment from hostile neighbors. Lar coordinates scouts and warriors to monitor coastal movements and curb the aggression of hostile forces—particularly the Kolkar centaur—ensuring the fragile settlement has room to breathe.
